aka.zh: A30 公路（上海 2001 年的编号）
G1501（2019 年以前的国家编号）

tagline.en: Shanghai's outer ring, still a 'C' rather than an 'O': open all the way round except for the last stretch on the Pudong bank of the Yangtze
tagline.zh: 上海最外围的环线，至今仍是“C”字而非“O”字：除浦东长江沿岸最后一段外均已通车

start.en: Near Anting, Jiading district, by the Jiangsu border, where the drawn line begins
start.zh: 嘉定区安亭附近、沪苏交界处，所绘线段由此开始

end.en: The Pudong end of the riverside tunnel under the Yangtze and Huangpu, where G1503 meets the S20 Outer Ring; the Pudong riverside section that will close the ring is still being built
end.zh: 穿越长江、黄浦江的郊环隧道浦东端，G1503 在此与 S20 外环高速相接；使环线闭合的沿江通道浦东段仍在建设

en: G1503 is Shanghai's outermost ring, well beyond the S20 Outer Ring, through the districts of Pudong, Fengxian, Jinshan, Songjiang, Qingpu, Jiading and Baoshan, with a short stretch across the border at Huaqiao in Kunshan, Jiangsu, where it meets the Beijing–Shanghai expressway. When complete it will be about 208 km round. It is not yet a closed ring. The gap is on the Pudong bank of the Yangtze mouth, between the riverside tunnel and the Wuzhou Avenue area, where traffic still has to use the S20 Outer Ring.

The road was assembled from pieces with other names. Shanghai's 2001 numbering called the suburban ring A30. Its components include a stretch of the Tongsan (Tongjiang–Sanya) national trunk road, and the first part to open was the first phase of the Jiading–Liuhe expressway. The national network numbered it G1501. Under the 2013–2030 national highway plan it became G1503, and Shanghai changed 1,524 signs between April and June 2019.
zh: G1503 是上海最外围的环线，位于 S20 外环高速以外，途经浦东、奉贤、金山、松江、青浦、嘉定、宝山各区，并有一小段越过省界经江苏昆山花桥，与京沪高速相交。全部建成后全长约 208 公里。它目前还不是闭合环线：缺口在长江口浦东一岸，介于郊环隧道与五洲大道一带之间，车辆仍须经 S20 外环高速通行。
这条路由多段原有名称各异的道路拼成。上海 2001 年的编号把郊区环线定为 A30 公路；其组成部分包括同三国道（同江—三亚）的一段，最早通车的则是嘉浏高速一期。国家高速公路网曾将其编为 G1501；按《国家公路网规划（2013年—2030年）》改编为 G1503，上海于 2019 年 4 月至 6 月间更换了 1524 块交通标志。

en: The hardest piece is the crossing of the river mouth at Wusong. The riverside tunnel, opened in 2019, runs from Mudanjiang Road in Baoshan under the Yangtze and the Huangpu to the S20 east of Shuangjiang Road in Pudong. The whole project is about 8.7 km long, with tunnel bores of about 6.5 km; it was bored with two machines of about 15.4 metres, giving a tunnel 15 metres across outside, and has six lanes for 80 km/h. It was the first tunnel in Shanghai to pass under both the Yangtze and the Huangpu, and the longest and widest under the Huangpu when it was begun.

The Pudong section that will close the ring, about 18 km, is being built mostly as viaduct for 100 km/h, beside the S20 and then along Wuzhou Avenue, coming down to ground at the Gaodong toll station to join the existing G1503 at the G40 interchange. Its contractors said 90% of the bridge structure was prefabricated and assembled on site.
zh: 最难的一段是吴淞口的越江工程。2019 年通车的郊环隧道西起宝山区牡丹江路，穿越长江和黄浦江，止于浦东外环线双江路以东。工程全长约 8.7 公里，隧道段约 6.5 公里；由两台直径约 15.4 米的盾构机掘进，隧道外径 15 米，双向六车道，设计车速 80 公里/小时。它是上海首条连续穿越长江和黄浦江的隧道，开工时刷新了黄浦江底隧道最长、最大的纪录。
将使环线闭合的浦东段长约 18 公里，以高架为主，设计速度 100 公里/小时，先沿 S20 南行，再折向五洲大道，在高东收费站附近落地，于 G40 立交接入现状 G1503。施工方称，该工程桥梁结构的预制装配率达到 90%。

en: The ring opened in pieces. By the dates in Chinese Wikipedia, taken from the Shanghai yearbooks and press reports, the first part, the first phase of the Jiading–Liuhe expressway, opened in 2000; the Tongsan section on 27 December 2002; the first phase of the north section on 3 September 2004; the south-east section on 29 December 2004; the second phase of the north section on 31 December 2004; and the south section on 23 December 2005.

The Pudong section, 24.42 km from Wenju Road past the airport to the S20, opened on 30 October 2009, the day before the Shanghai Yangtze tunnel and bridge to Chongming; the road was then described as about 190 km long and complete, with the stretch from the Outer Ring tunnel to Wuzhou Avenue shared with the S20. To make it a ring of its own, a new crossing was needed at Wusong. Work on the riverside tunnel began on 6 December 2014 and it opened on 28 December 2019. The Puxi approach in Baoshan opened in part on 25 November 2022 and the rest on 27 September 2023. The Pudong section was begun on 28 September 2020 and was planned for completion at the end of 2024; as of 2026 it was still under construction.
zh: 环线分段建成。按中文维基百科依据《上海年鉴》和新闻报道所列日期，最早的嘉浏高速一期于 2000 年通车；同三段于 2002 年 12 月 27 日通车；北段一期于 2004 年 9 月 3 日通车；东南段于 2004 年 12 月 29 日通车；北段二期于 2004 年 12 月 31 日通车；南段于 2005 年 12 月 23 日通车。

浦东段自闻居路经浦东机场至 S20，全长 24.42 公里，于 2009 年 10 月 30 日通车，比通往崇明的上海长江隧桥早一天；当时称这条全长约 190 公里的绕城高速全线贯通，其中外环隧道至五洲大道段与 S20 共线。要让它独立成环，还须在吴淞口另建越江通道。郊环隧道于 2014 年 12 月 6 日开工，2019 年 12 月 28 日通车；宝山区的浦西接线段于 2022 年 11 月 25 日部分通车，其余路段于 2023 年 9 月 27 日通车。浦东段于 2020 年 9 月 28 日开工，原计划 2024 年底竣工；截至 2026 年仍在施工。

en: No total has been published; the ring was built over two decades as separate projects by different companies. The figures found are for the river crossing: the riverside tunnel was budgeted at about 7.2625 billion yuan when work began in 2014, and the seven main-line contracts for the Pudong section were let for 5.735 billion yuan in 2020. A project database gives the Pudong section's total investment as 13.024 billion; that figure has not been found in an official source.

Each piece had its own investor. The 2009 Pudong section was invested and built by the Shanghai East Ring Expressway Development Co. The riverside tunnel was invested by the Shanghai Chengtou Highway Investment group. The Pudong section's main line is being paid for by the Shanghai Chengtou group and its parallel ground-level roads by the Pudong New Area.
zh: 全线没有公开的总造价；这条环线二十年间由不同公司分项目建设。查到的数字集中在越江段：郊环隧道 2014 年开工时总投资约 72.625 亿元；浦东段主线 7 个施工标段于 2020 年中标，总中标金额 57.35 亿元。一个工程项目数据库称浦东段投资 130.24 亿元，该数字未在官方来源中查到。
各段投资方各不相同。2009 年通车的浦东段由上海东环高速公路发展有限公司投资建设；郊环隧道由上海城投公路投资（集团）有限公司投资；浦东段主线由上海城投集团投资，两侧地面辅道由浦东新区投资。

en: The Pudong section built in 2009 has six lanes for 100 km/h. Until the ring is closed, drivers going round the north-east have to use the S20 Outer Ring between the riverside tunnel and Wuzhou Avenue. Since November 2022 the 21.5 km of G1503 in Jiading has been open to testing of self-driving vehicles.
zh: 2009 年建成的浦东段为双向六车道，设计时速 100 公里。环线闭合以前，绕行东北方向的车辆在郊环隧道与五洲大道之间须经 S20 外环高速。自 2022 年 11 月起，嘉定区境内 21.5 公里的 G1503 路段向自动驾驶测试开放。

why.en: No route-wide figure is published. Like other national expressways, G1503 was built in pieces, from 2000 onwards, by different investors, and its cost is reported only per project; the sourced figures are listed separately below.
why.zh: 未公布全线总造价。与其他国家高速公路一样，G1503 自 2000 年起由不同投资方分段建设，造价仅按项目公布；有来源的数字另列如下。

label.en: Riverside tunnel under the Yangtze and Huangpu (about 8.7 km, 2014–2019)
label.zh: 郊环隧道（沿江通道越江段，约 8.7 公里，2014—2019）

figures.source: People's Daily Online, 6 December 2014; Xinmin Evening News, 28 December 2019

label.en: Pudong riverside section (about 18 km, under construction)
label.zh: 沿江通道浦东段（约 18 公里，在建）

value.en: Main-line contracts let for 5.735 billion yuan (2020). Total investment reported at 13.024 billion yuan by a project database; not checked against an official source.
value.zh: 主线施工 7 个标段总中标金额 57.35 亿元（2020）。总投资据工程项目数据库为 130.24 亿元，未与官方来源核对。

figures.source: People's Daily Online (Shanghai), 22 September 2020; tgnet.com project record, updated August 2026

value.en: By section: the 2009 Pudong section by the Shanghai East Ring Expressway Development Co.; the riverside tunnel by the Shanghai Chengtou Highway Investment group; the Pudong riverside main line by the Shanghai Chengtou group, with its ground-level roads paid for by the Pudong New Area. Investors for the older sections have not been found.
value.zh: 分段出资：2009 年通车的浦东段由上海东环高速公路发展有限公司投资建设；郊环隧道由上海城投公路投资（集团）有限公司投资；沿江通道浦东段主线由上海城投集团投资，地面辅道由浦东新区投资。较早路段的投资方未查到。

figures.source: Xinwen Chenbao via Sina, 30 October 2009; tunnelling.cn interview on the riverside tunnel; Pudong government release via Sina, 28 September 2020

value.en: About 208 km when closed; about 190 km when described as complete in 2009, sharing part of the S20
value.zh: 闭合后约 208 公里；2009 年称全线贯通时约 190 公里，部分与 S20 共线

figures.source: People's Daily Online (Shanghai), 22 September 2020; 56885.net, report on the opening of the Pudong section, October 2009; Dragon TV via Sohu, 30 October 2009

timeline.en: The first phase of the Jiading–Liuhe expressway, later part of the ring, opens.
timeline.zh: 后来并入环线的嘉浏高速一期通车。

timeline.en: Shanghai numbers the suburban ring A30.
timeline.zh: 上海将郊区环线编为 A30 公路。

timeline.en: The Tongsan section opens on 27 December.
The north section's first phase opens on 3 September; the south-east section and the north section's second phase open at the end of December.
timeline.zh: 9 月 3 日北段一期通车；12 月底，东南段与北段二期相继通车。

timeline.en: The south section opens on 23 December.
The Pudong section opens on 30 October.
Work begins on the riverside tunnel on 6 December.
timeline.zh: 12 月 6 日，郊环隧道开工。

timeline.en: The ring is renumbered G1503 by June; the riverside tunnel opens on 28 December.
timeline.zh: 6 月前完成改编为 G1503；12 月 28 日，郊环隧道通车。

timeline.en: Work begins on the Pudong riverside section on 28 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 28 日，沿江通道浦东段开工。

timeline.en: The Puxi approach in Baoshan is complete on 27 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 27 日，宝山区浦西接线段全部通车。
